blocks.title: ManiaExchange Random Map Picker
blocks.tagline: Openplanet plugin that picks random maps from ManiaExchange and runs the Random Map Challenge game modes.

items.title: Random Map Challenge
items.text: Play random maps taken from ManiaExchange.

items.title: Game modes
items.text: Includes Survival and Together modes and other variants.

items.title: In the plugin menu
items.text: Open the game modes from Play Random Map Challenge in the Openplanet plugins menu.

blocks.title: Notes
blocks.markdown: The author notes that a skipped map that does not switch in the Together mode is a Nadeo issue; a vote skip to the next map should work. Leaderboard and rules are on flinkblog.de/RMC.
